run_maskcut_demo: run the maskcut demo CLI to segment an image using DINO ViT features and save output
run_maskcut_with_custom_model: run the maskcut demo with a custom pretrained model path and ViT base architecture
run_maskcut_cpu: run the maskcut demo on CPU with a specified image path and output directory
review_vis_mask: review the vis_mask function that overlays a colored mask on an input image array
refactor_maskcut_pipeline: refactor the maskcut demo pipeline to support batch image processing with CRF post-processing
